tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The ground every figure and article sits on.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, figure frames and context (non-subject) top faces in isometric drawings.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Code blocks, byte-layout cells, the ground plane inside a figure.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: rules, graticules, table borders, context-feature outlines. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and of dashed/optional elements; 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figure linework, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, figure annotations; on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: ground-plane graticule, construction lines, inactive ticks.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: THE accent and the brand. In figures it marks the subject: exactly one thing per figure. As a fill for large marks and the primary button; not for body text (use magenta-ink).

tokens.name: magenta-ink
tokens.usage: Magenta as text: links, the subject's label in a figure, active nav. On paper, paper-raised and magenta-soft.

tokens.name: magenta-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind subject areas: subject polygon fills, highlighted byte cells, active rows. magenta-ink text reads on it.

tokens.name: magenta-light
tokens.usage: Isometric left face of the subject; light tints in tonal sequences.

tokens.name: magenta-deep
tokens.usage: Isometric right (shadow) face of the subject; deepest tone in tonal sequences.

tokens.name: on-magenta
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a magenta fill (primary button label, a subject tile's extension label).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Second process ink, used only for the 'other' side of a comparison (legacy vs modern, planar vs geodesic). Never decorative; at most one cyan element per figure.

tokens.name: cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan as text, on paper, paper-raised and cyan-soft.

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind the comparison side.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Corrections and 'needs verification' labels, as text on paper, paper-raised and amber-soft.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Background of correction callouts.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in articles (underlined).

tokens.name: iso-top
tokens.usage: Subject top face in isometric drawings (light comes from the upper left).

tokens.name: iso-left
tokens.usage: Subject left (lit) vertical face.

tokens.name: iso-right
tokens.usage: Subject right (shaded) vertical face.

tokens.name: ctx-top
tokens.usage: Context feature top face.

tokens.name: ctx-left
tokens.usage: Context feature left face.

tokens.name: ctx-right
tokens.usage: Context feature right face.

families.serif: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Site name and volume openers only. Set font-stretch 118%.

styles.name: label-map
styles.usage: Uppercase, wide-spaced map-label style: eyebrows, figure numbers, legend headers, volume markers. Always uppercase; font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags, nav, legend items. Sentence case.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A geographic information system is defined less by maps than by what it lets you ask.
styles.usage: The one-paragraph standfirst under an article title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Canada Land Inventory's maps could not be examined manually in any sensible time.
styles.usage: Long-form article text, 60–70 characters a line.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Fig. 2. One question asked three ways.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figure annotations: coordinates, byte offsets, CRS lines, dates in timelines, article IDs.

styles.name: data-s
styles.usage: Dense annotations inside diagrams (byte cells, tick labels).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; vertex-handle inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and badges; legend item gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and byte cells; caption gap below a figure.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and callout padding on phones; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and callout padding; the figure graticule pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Figure inner padding; gap between paragraphs and figures.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between article sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top margin, volume openers.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Figures, frames, byte cells, isometric faces: maps have square neatlines.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

stroke.note: Line weights for figures and UI.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Graticules, context outlines, rules.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Glyphs, figure linework, subject outlines in isometric drawings.

tokens.name: stroke-feature
tokens.usage: The subject line or boundary in a plan-view sketch.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

geometry.note: Fixed geometry of the isometric and plan-view drawing system.

tokens.name: iso-angle
tokens.usage: True isometric axes: 30° above horizontal. Never 26.57° (2:1 pixel isometric).

tokens.name: vertex-size
tokens.usage: Vertex handle: a square, paper fill, stroke-line outline.

tokens.name: node-size
tokens.usage: Node: a circle of this diameter, where arcs meet or end.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Graticule pitch on figure ground planes (space-5).
